queries.query: “large language model” OR LLM AND ("network operations" OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR "network management" OR AIOps)
queries.rationale: Broad sweep to locate direct intersections of LLM research and NetOps/AIOps: surveys, position papers, proof-of-concept studies, and early experiment reports.
source_preferences: IEEE Xplore (CNSM, Transactions on Network and Service Management)

queries.query: LLM hallucinat* OR "hallucination" AND ("network" OR "router" OR "switch" OR "network configuration" OR "access control")
queries.rationale: Capture phenomenon of factual errors / invented content when LLMs generate network artifacts or instructions; relevant to operational safety.

queries.query: "intent-to-configuration" OR "intent to configuration" OR "natural language to network configuration" OR "translate intent" AND (SDN OR "network config" OR "NetConf" OR "YANG")
queries.rationale: Focus on pipelines that convert operator intent/natural language into device configurations—central operational use-case for generative models.

queries.query: generate-validate-repair OR "generate-then-verify" OR "tool-augmented LLM" OR "verifier-assisted generation" AND (network OR NetOps OR "configuration")
queries.rationale: Discover architectures that combine LLM generation with validators/repairers—key mitigation pattern for operational robustness.

queries.query: Batfish OR VeriFlow OR Anteater OR NetKAT OR "network verification" OR "header space analysis" OR "reachability analysis"
queries.rationale: Locate classical and modern deterministic network verification tools/papers (useful as validators or simulators in LLM-for-NetOps pipelines).
source_preferences: tool project pages / GitHub (Batfish, VeriFlow, NetKAT)

queries.query: "agentic" OR "agentic AI" OR "autonomous agent" AND ("network" OR NetOps OR "network management" OR "autonomous network")
queries.rationale: Find literature on agentic/autonomous agents applied to network management and safety frameworks for agentic behavior.

queries.query: bench* OR evaluation OR "benchmark" AND ("LLM" OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR AIOps)
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmarks and evaluation suites for LLMs in networking/AIOps and literature critiquing benchmark validity.

queries.query: adversarial OR "prompt injection" OR "supply chain attack" OR "malicious prompt" AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR configuration OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Search for security/attack vectors relevant to LLM-driven NetOps: prompt injection, adversarial examples, poisoning, maliciously crafted intents.

queries.query: "formal verification" OR SMT OR model-check* OR "runtime verification" AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR reachability OR "access control list" OR ACL)
queries.rationale: Methods for provable correctness and runtime enforcement applicable as mitigations or validators for generated configs.

queries.query: Mininet OR ns-3 OR emulation OR "network testbed" AND ("configuration testing" OR "simulation" OR "validation")
queries.rationale: Locate emulation/simulation platforms and testbeds used for executing and validating generated network configurations or workflows.

queries.query: LLM code generation "network config" OR "infrastructure as code" OR IaC AND ("Terraform" OR "Ansible" OR "netmiko" OR "napalm")
queries.rationale: Discover intersections of LLM code-generation capabilities and infrastructure-as-code tools used in network automation.

queries.query: "human-in-the-loop" OR "operator oversight" OR "human oversight" AND (NetOps OR "network operations" OR LLM)
queries.rationale: Explore work on appropriate human interventions, approval workflows, and HCI considerations for LLM-assisted NetOps.

queries.query: "runtime enforcement" OR shielding OR "safety layer" OR "shield" AND (autonomous agent OR LLM OR "network automation")
queries.rationale: Search for safety-engineering patterns (shields/runtime enforcement) that can be applied to prevent unsafe network changes.

queries.query: "evaluation metric" OR "operational metric" AND (reachability OR connectivity OR "policy compliance" OR "access control" OR loop OR blackhole) AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Identify concrete, operationally-relevant metrics and test oracles that objectively measure correctness/safety of network configs.

queries.query: "datasets" OR "corpora" AND ("network configuration" OR "router configs" OR "switch configs" OR "BGP data" OR "ACL dataset")
queries.rationale: Find public datasets of real or simulated network configs and operational traces suitable for evaluation and reproducibility.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed papers (conferences, journals) or publicly archived preprints (arXiv) with verifiable metadata (title, authors, year, venue/identifier).
Tool/project pages and code repositories (GitHub/GitLab) that provide reproducible artifacts, documentation, or datasets referenced by academic work.
Work that directly addresses LLMs/agentic AI applied to network operations, or established network verification/validation methods applicable as validators.
Security literature covering attacks or failure modes relevant to LLM-driven operational pipelines.
Public datasets, benchmarks, testbeds, and RFCs or standards documents relevant to network configuration and automation.
exclusion_criteria: Non-public, proprietary vendor-internal documents or datasets without public access.
Unverified blog posts, marketing materials, social-media threads, or anonymous forum posts used as primary scientific evidence.
Papers focused on general NLP tasks with no substantive application or evaluation in networking/NetOps contexts.
Benchmarks or datasets with no accessible description, code, or data artifacts preventing reproducibility or verification.
date_rationale: Search window: include foundational network-verification and program-synthesis work from ~2008–present (to capture established tools like header-space analysis, VeriFlow, NetKAT) and emphasize 2018–2026 for rapid developments in LLMs, agentic systems, and recent AIOps/LLM-for-NetOps studies. This balances inclusion of seminal older methods (needed as validators/mitigations) with the latest LLM/agentic literature and benchmarks.
